_about: Phone budgets per model (Galaxy F15 class). tris = triangles drawn, draws = mesh primitives (one draw call each), bytes = download size. A file entry overrides its folder; a folder overrides the default.

kits/._note: a kit is a library: the world draws a few of its pieces, instanced

atelier/._note: facade study architecture; camera proxy has many small boxes

characters/._note: a body kit is a library of parts; the game merges each person's parts into one draw call
